# Maps an FFM struct layout constant to the C type it mirrors, so the audit can compare its size
# and every named field's offset against the real header. A layout with no entry here is reported
# as unmapped and is not checked -- adding a line is the act of claiming which struct it models,
# which is the review step this file exists to force.
# Format: <JAVA_LAYOUT_CONSTANT> = <C type expression>, or <File.NAME> when the name is not unique.

# -- winnt.h / winbase.h
EVENTLOGRECORD           = EVENTLOGRECORD
LUID                     = LUID
LUID_AND_ATTRIBUTES      = LUID_AND_ATTRIBUTES
TOKEN_ELEVATION          = TOKEN_ELEVATION
TOKEN_PRIVILEGES         = TOKEN_PRIVILEGES
SYSTEMTIME_LAYOUT        = SYSTEMTIME
# szCSDVersion is JAVA_CHAR[128], so this is the wide variant
OSVERSIONINFOEX          = OSVERSIONINFOEXW

# -- psapi.h; both files describe the same struct
PERFORMANCE_INFORMATION        = PERFORMANCE_INFORMATION
PERFORMANCE_INFORMATION_LAYOUT = PERFORMANCE_INFORMATION

# -- iphlpapi.h
FIXED_INFO_LAYOUT            = FIXED_INFO
IP_ADDRESS_STRING_LAYOUT     = IP_ADDRESS_STRING
IP_ADDR_STRING_LAYOUT        = IP_ADDR_STRING
MIB_TCPROW_OWNER_PID_LAYOUT  = MIB_TCPROW_OWNER_PID
MIB_TCP6ROW_OWNER_PID_LAYOUT = MIB_TCP6ROW_OWNER_PID
MIB_TCPSTATS_LAYOUT          = MIB_TCPSTATS
MIB_UDPROW_OWNER_PID_LAYOUT  = MIB_UDPROW_OWNER_PID
MIB_UDP6ROW_OWNER_PID_LAYOUT = MIB_UDP6ROW_OWNER_PID
MIB_UDPSTATS_LAYOUT          = MIB_UDPSTATS

# -- pdh.h, setupapi.h, objbase.h, oleauto.h
PDH_RAW_COUNTER_LAYOUT   = PDH_RAW_COUNTER
SP_DEVICE_INTERFACE_DATA = SP_DEVICE_INTERFACE_DATA
GuidFFM.LAYOUT           = GUID
VariantFFM.LAYOUT        = VARIANT

# -- powrprof.h / batclass.h
BATTERY_INFORMATION      = BATTERY_INFORMATION
BATTERY_MANUFACTURE_DATE = BATTERY_MANUFACTURE_DATE
BATTERY_QUERY_INFORMATION = BATTERY_QUERY_INFORMATION
BATTERY_STATUS           = BATTERY_STATUS
BATTERY_WAIT_STATUS      = BATTERY_WAIT_STATUS

# -- bluetoothapis.h
BLUETOOTH_DEVICE_INFO_LAYOUT          = BLUETOOTH_DEVICE_INFO
BLUETOOTH_DEVICE_SEARCH_PARAMS_LAYOUT = BLUETOOTH_DEVICE_SEARCH_PARAMS
BLUETOOTH_FIND_RADIO_PARAMS_LAYOUT    = BLUETOOTH_FIND_RADIO_PARAMS
BLUETOOTH_RADIO_INFO_LAYOUT           = BLUETOOTH_RADIO_INFO

# -- winternl.h. The SDK declares these only as partial stubs with Reserved members, so most of
# their fields report as absent and are skipped; the size assert is still worth having.
#
# CURDIR and RTL_DRIVE_LETTER_CURDIR are deliberately left unmapped: winternl.h does not declare
# them at all, so there is nothing to compare against. They will show as unmapped, which is honest.
UNICODE_STRING                   = UNICODE_STRING
STRING                           = STRING
PEB                              = PEB
PROCESS_BASIC_INFORMATION_STRUCT = PROCESS_BASIC_INFORMATION
RTL_USER_PROCESS_PARAMETERS      = RTL_USER_PROCESS_PARAMETERS
